# git-github-mcp: Industrial Git/GitHub substrate
> [Agentic Revolution Manifesto](https://github.com/sandraschi/mcp-central-docs/blob/master/manifesto/AGENTIC_REVOLUTION.md) | [SOTA v14.x Standard]
> FastMCP 3.2+ hardened substrate for Git and GitHub operations. Uses `gh` CLI for GitHub; v1.20 non-interactive safety enforced. High-fidelity telemetry for commits, PRs, issues, and repo management.

## Architecture
- **Backend (Port 10713)**: Python/FastAPI wrapper for Git/GitHub CLI.
- **Frontend (Port 10714)**: Vite-based dashboard for fleet telemetry, stars trajectory, and CI success+failed stats.
- **Discovery**: Automatic `gh.exe` detection across standard Windows paths.

## Maintainer fleet triage
- **Web:** route **`/inbox`** — PRs & Issues tabs, optional **fleet** mode (many `owner/repo` lines), same data as `github_ops`.
- **Schedule:** A **supervisor** (robofang, OpenManus, OpenClaw, …) should run daily/weekly `pr_list` / `issue_list` across your repo list; MCP has no cron. Fleet doc: **mcp-central-docs** `patterns/GITHUB_MAINTAINER_HEARTBEAT.md`.

This project includes automated llms.txt generation for AI accessibility.
